bio: This inn dates back to 1490. In cosy, charmingly decorated dining rooms with touches of elegance, or out on the wonderful garden terrace, diners are invited to savour creatively inspired cuisine with regional foundations. Dishes such as clear mushroom consommé, chive oil, game ravioli, or red catfish, cucumber, rhubarb are accompanied by a fine selection of wines with a focus on Austrian winemakers. The guestrooms are a real home away from home....
